prompt:
Task: Estimate this reporting area’s next annual yield for the specified cereal crop, using its three preceding annual yields.
Target: next_annual_crop_yield
Target unit: kg/ha
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing.
Field definitions and context: reporting_area is the FAOSTAT country or territory name. crop is the cereal. target_year is the year of the requested yield. prior_annual_yields_kg_per_ha lists the three preceding annual observations, in chronological order, each measured in kilograms per harvested hectare.
Input JSON: {"reporting_area":"Armenia","crop":"Wheat","target_year":1995,"prior_annual_yields_kg_per_ha":[{"year":1992,"yield_kg_per_ha":2160},{"year":1993,"yield_kg_per_ha":2225.7},{"year":1994,"yield_kg_per_ha":1784.2}]}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
